issues.description: Method `getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()` has an inconsistent return type across artifacts: the problem statement/UML specifies `getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double`, but the solution implements `public int getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()`, causing integer division and contradicting the required signature (tests and student implementations will expect `double`).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution method signature to `public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()` and use floating-point division, e.g. `return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors();` (optionally define behavior for `numberOfTutors == 0`).
